paper_metadata.title: Rheocasting techniques applied to intermetallic TiAl alloys and composites

evidence.quote: An investigation was made on the homogenization of microstructures and improvement of mechanical properties in intermetallic TiAl binary, ternary and quaternary alloys and their composites produced by the rheocasting
intermetallic TiAl binary, ternary and quaternary alloys and their composites produced by the rheocasting

In order to produce structural titanium aluminides and composites with high ductility at room temperature and high strength at elevated temperature, an investigation was made on the homogeneous refinement of microstructures and improvement of mechanical properties by rotational agitation during the solidification of intermetallic TiAl binary, ternary and quaternary alloys and their composites.

For an example, in the microstructure of a Ti–44%Al alloy melted and solidified naturally without stirring in the rheocasting room, ordinary lamellar structures of TiAl and Ti3Al were obviously observed
